verdict.rationale: Google Antigravity is itself an agentic coding platform, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. All MCP evidence is client-side: connecting to MCP servers, configuring them via slash commands, bundling them in plugins, and layering them in the SDK. Nothing shows Antigravity running as an MCP server, such as a serve subcommand or a hosted endpoint, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
